name: Todd Fang
description: Todd Fang is a cunning soldier of the Sacred Vollachia Empire and the husband of Katya Aurélie. Masking an intensely pragmatic, ruthless survival instinct behind an easygoing facade, he instinctively recognized Natsuki Subaru as an unnatural, existential danger, becoming one of Subaru's most persistent and lethal nemeses across Arc 7 and Arc 8.
